findings.title: [P1] Restore the tenant boundary check
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally means a user from any tenant is authorized to read documents belonging to every other tenant. This removes the function’s sole access-control condition and creates a direct cross-tenant data exposure path wherever the exported check is enforced.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: At current head 52b7ce99a19d8dbc93e387a5d2971854fce37e73, src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally; the full base-to-head diff shows the tenant equality comparison was removed, so the claimed label-only fix does not restore tenant isolation.
